description: Find single MCP tools or A2A skills that do something, across all agents. Only endpoints that passed lcas's last daily check. Ordered by reliability, not by a score: endpoints whose weekly live test passed first, then by days working in the last 30, then by how well the words match. Each result has the endpoint to connect to and its check history.

chain.description: Chain ID: 1 = Ethereum, 8453 = Base. Omit for both.

money.description: Money hint on the tool's own text: moves funds, asks for payment, or reads prices/balances. Word matches, not verified.

query.description: Words to match in tool or skill names and descriptions, e.g. "weather forecast".

service.description: Only MCP tools or only A2A skills.

tested_only.description: Only endpoints whose last weekly live test passed.

tool_findings.description: Tool-poisoning scan of tools' own text (instruction phrasing aimed at the reading app, invisible Unicode, asks for secrets or to send data out, orders about other tools). exclude = hide matches, only = show only matches. Patterns catch lazy attacks only.

name: find_tools
title: Find tools
